name: sol-orchestrator
description: Classify conversations by default, route work visually, and fully pause Sol orchestration per workspace when needed.

interface.shortDescription: Default-on routing with a workspace off switch.
interface.longDescription: A Chinese orchestration dashboard that defaults to classifying each new conversation, routes simple work locally, previews Sol-worker-review budgets, and provides a workspace kill switch that blocks planning, execution, review, status, artifacts, agent dispatch, endpoint tests, and model calls until re-enabled.
defaultPrompt: Open the Sol Orchestrator tuning dashboard.
Classify this request and orchestrate only when justified.
